verdict.rationale: Orama's core search engine is an open-source library that you embed and run in your own application, in the browser, or under Deno, at no cost. The managed Orama Cloud context server also has documented on-premise deployment on your own infrastructure. The docs state that Cloud and Open Source APIs are aligned, so projects can move between the two. Missing for 10: detailed self-hosting and on-prem deployment documentation for the Cloud context server, explicit license terms, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: The open-source search library. Add fast, relevant search to your own application at no cost.
We offer on-premise support for Orama Cloud, allowing you to deploy the context server on your own infrastructure.
It runs in your cloud, on-prem, or dedicated
so you can easily migrate your projects from **Orama Cloud** to **Orama Open Source** and vice-versa.
